name: Kinetic typography as the whole film
look: words are the only image: scale, slam, morph, wordplay; no UI until the end.

fits.notes: manifestos, rebrands, strong copy; Apple-keynote-style releases

when_not: Avoid when the product demo is the point, or weak copy.

type.guidance: variable fonts (Inter Display, Söhne, GT America, PP Neue Montreal, Druk for punch)
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text.

colour.guidance: variable fonts (Inter Display, Söhne, GT America, PP Neue Montreal, Druk for punch); 2 colours + black.
colour.rule: Style palette fills the world; the brand colour takes the role named in brand_lock.colour_role and never drops below the contrast of the brand's own palette.

keeps: real product UI capture (composited as a screen plate, never redrawn)
brand_lock.colour_role: brand colour is the colour flip on the key word; 2 colours plus black
brand_lock.type_role: the brand face IS the film: variable weight, scale, slam, morph
brand_lock.world_changes: words are the only image until the product proof at the end
brand_lock.rule: Under a brand lock the brand colour, type and logo stay; the style world (material, picture language, motion grammar, finish, sound) is what varies between looks. A branded launch shows 3 different style worlds.

motion_grammar.note: grammars lists existing library/grammars ids; grammars_planned lists world grammars the engine plan adds (game-world, tabletop, os-desktop, type-only, editorial, collage, cinematic-world).

effects.role: optional, keeps flat colour fields from banding

effects_note: rasan-fx passes (runtime/rasan-fx.js); order is the pass order. {brand_colour} / {second_ink} are filled from the brand or look palette.

codex_assets.prompt_template: one texture plate for a type fill: {texture}, flat lighting
codex_assets.r1_note: none needed, or one texture plate for type fills.
codex_assets.rules: Flat, evenly lit plain background (chroma green or pure white) for clean cut-outs; one prompt family with the same seed words; generate at 2x and downscale; never ask Codex for readable UI text or logos (typeset them in HTML).

palette: hits on word impacts, risers, a voice or drum-driven beat

build.engine_meaning: buildable today / reference only (builder hand-codes it)

product_ui_rule: If the film shows RasanAI Studio, use the current dark sidebar UI with the Describe...Final dot stepper (docs/brand/studio-ui/), as a real capture composited INTO this style; never the retired light UI.

palettes.name: Ink on bone
palettes.words: bone white, ink black, signal orange, electric blue

palettes.name: Colour field
palettes.words: electric blue field, cream, taxi yellow, pink

brand_lock.rule: Typography is the brand: brand type sets every word; brand colour may take the background or the one accent word; the other stays style-fixed. Never both bg and ink in brand colour (no contrast). Slots marked brand take the brand colour (exact hex); slots marked style keep the palette value; brand-or-style takes the brand colour only when its contrast against the other slot is at least 4.5:1, else the palette value.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

pairings.note: One word fills 60-90% of frame width; lh .86; optical size tight.

scale.note: cqw = 1% of the frame width (1080p: 1cqw = 19.2 px)

type.load: In a HyperFrames composition add the two <link> tags from `google` to <head> (plus rel=preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com), set font-family from `css`, and wait for document.fonts.ready before the first screenshot / timeline build. Offline renders: download the families once (they are OFL) into the project's fonts/ folder and use @font-face. The brand face always sets the real claim line and the product UI text; the style pairing is for the world's chrome and display.
type.rule: Style type is for the world's chrome and display; the brand face always sets the real claim line and any product UI text. Under a brand lock keep the brand face for the claim and use the pairing's display for labels only.

passes.role: quiet grain only; the type is the show

finish.how: Runtime: RasanFX.create({ source, passes: [...] }) from runtime/rasan-fx.js, applied in the listed order, on the whole composition canvas or on the Codex plate only (plate-only when the type must stay crisp). `css` lists the cheap approximation kinds story boards and style frames draw with plain CSS (grain:<opacity>, scan:<opacity>, halftone, pixel, led-dots ...).

composition.grid: one word per beat on a 12-col grid; baseline snapped to a 1/12 frame-height grid
composition.safe_area: 5% margin; words may crop on one edge intentionally
composition.fill: type fills 60-90% of width, one idea per frame
composition.product_ui: UI, if shown, is a rectangle that enters as one more word block; do not float it over type

codex.template: {subject} {action}, {setting}. Camera and lens: not applicable (typographic plate); if an image is needed it is a flat graphic plate, no perspective. Lighting: none: flat graphic colour. Material: pure flat colour and glyph shapes. Colour, locked to the palette {palette_words}, and nothing outside it. Texture and finish: a faint film grain only. Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no illustrations, no icons, no gradients, no drop shadows, no photographs, no decorative flourishes.
codex.camera: not applicable (typographic plate); if an image is needed it is a flat graphic plate, no perspective
codex.material: pure flat colour and glyph shapes
codex.colour_rule: Name the palette's colours in words (the palette's `words`), never hex codes; add 'and nothing outside this palette'. Pick one palette per film and keep it.

aspect.note: Plates: ask for about 12% bleed around the frame so the camera can travel; keep the calm side empty for type. Generate 16:9 for the frame, 1:1 for sprite sheets and objects.

consistency.anchor: Make the anchor plate first, approve it by eye, then pass it as --ref to every other image (imagegen batch does this with --world).
consistency.style_line: Append the world bible's style line (30-45 words, no hex) to every prompt.
consistency.seed_words: Keep these words verbatim in every prompt of the film: pure flat colour and glyph shapes; not applicable (typographic plate); if an image is needed it is a flat graphic plate; bone white, ink black, signal orange, electric blue.

sprite_sheet.rules: Not a sprite style. For a cut-out object or character use --transparent (flat #00FF00 key, then despill); one subject, no shadow plane.

examples.action: slightly cropped at the right edge
examples.setting: flat bone background with a hairline baseline

Avoid: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no illustrations, no icons, no gradients, no drop shadows, no photographs, no decorative flourishes.

examples.subject: a flat acid-lime rectangle
examples.action: slides in and splits a black screen into two columns
examples.prompt: a flat acid-lime rectangle slides in and splits a black screen into two columns, near-black room, no other objects. do: One idea per frame; the word is the picture
Change scale, weight and axis between beats, not typeface
Hit the cut on the stressed syllable
dont: No bounce easing on every word
cheap_ways: Every word fades up from below at the same speed
Text centred and small with a lot of empty space
Random fonts per word without a system
